Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics

Record Class CosmeticOwnership

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.cosmetics.CosmeticOwnership
Record Components:
category - the built-in category, or null for an addon's type
owned - the owned cosmetic IDs, in the order they were granted
selected - the chosen cosmetic's ID, or null for the server's default
expiries - when each timed cosmetic expires, by ID; empty when every one is permanent
type - the type, built-in or an addon's (since 1.11.0)
public record CosmeticOwnership(@Nullable CosmeticCategory category, @NotNull Set<String> owned, @Nullable String selected, @NotNull Map<String,Instant> expiries, @NotNull CosmeticTypeKey type) extends Record
What one player owns and chose in one cosmetic category. A snapshot.

Owning a cosmetic an administrator later deleted is kept, and counts again once a cosmetic with that ID exists.

A cosmetic granted for a limited time has an entry in expiries; one without an entry is owned permanently. Expired cosmetics are never listed: Zentrix removes them as they expire, also for players who were offline at the time.

Since 1.11.0 ownership also describes an addon's type, whose category is null. Ownership read through the 1.8.0 methods, which take a CosmeticCategory, always has one.

Since:
1.8.0
